summary.title: SME Programmer's Guide
summary.one_liner: Arm's guide to the Scalable Matrix Extension (SME), covering how to use it to work efficiently with matrices and other data, with SME2 int8 and f32 matmul and gemv kernel examples per the listing.
takeaways: SME is Arm's Scalable Matrix Extension, used to work efficiently with matrices and other data.
The guide (version 1.1, issued 9 October 2025) includes code examples, updated to stop using the platform register x18.
The listing describes SME2 int8 and f32 matmul and gemv kernels plus a lookup-table path.
The listing notes the unit is so far only in client parts.
The page text provided is mostly legal and release boilerplate, so the technical content is not visible in this excerpt.
summary.summary: This is Arm's SME Programmer's Guide (version 1.1, Final status, non-confidential), which introduces the Scalable Matrix Extension and shows how it can be used to efficiently work with matrices and other data. The page text captured here is mainly release history, legal notices, and feedback information, so the technical sections are not visible in this excerpt. According to the index listing, the guide walks through SME2 int8 and f32 matmul and gemv kernels and a lookup-table path, and notes the unit is so far only in client parts.
